items.title: XRP holders face a choice between earning more yield and getting their tokens back
items.teaser: Spectra’s February market keeps XRP-linked exposure on Flare, while getting native XRP back takes a separate redemption. Read the full story on CryptoSlate Understand the crypto stories that matter …

items.title: Brazil’s stock exchange teams up with major banks to launch real-pegged stablecoin
items.teaser: Banco B3 will issue the token, backed one-to-one by reais, and other financial institutions can join from launch.

items.title: Ethereum devs schedule Glamsterdam upgrade for Hoodi testnet on Dec. 15
items.teaser: Developers also discussed whether post-quantum readiness should trump other proposals set for the subsequent Ethereum upgrade, Hegotá.

items.title: New York AG secures $1.37B court judgment against NovaTech founders
items.teaser: The judgment follows an August 2025 default ruling against the founders over a Ponzi scheme that targeted Haitian and other immigrant communities.

items.title: Ripple's lending plan moves closer to tapping XRP Ledger's $800 million in stablecoins
items.teaser: The vaults that would hold lenders' money are on track to switch on Dec. 9. The loan system that draws from them still needs one more validator to start its own two-week clock.

items.title: Binance says customer withdrawals are fully restored, four weeks after the $6.3 billion hack
items.teaser: Binance says it has fully lifted withdrawal suspensions imposed after October’s $6.3 billion hack, though a small number of networks remain paused for unrelated maintenance.
